title: Lesion-Aware Attention for Mammography Segmentation with Heterogeneous Supervision
mechanism: Two-branch mixed supervision: masks for base classes, image labels for more classes; a lesion-wise attentive classifier with per-class prototypes pools features only over lesion-like regions.
evidence: Consistent gains over open-vocabulary baselines on several mammography datasets; better localisation of small, low-contrast findings (qualitative).
adaptation: Prototype-attention pooling for the ELPV cell-level head so the cell label is not explained by gridlines or borders; aimed at BMRK inactive and false alarms.
min_experiment: Variant of ELPV arm: prototype-attention pooling vs plain MIL head, 5 seeds each. Metric: BMRK inactive IoU (5-fold CV), crack precision. Kill if no gain over plain MIL head by 0.03 inactive IoU. ~8 GPU-h.
